:::{#thm-wcgs-personality}

#### Interpretation of the personality coefficient in the WCGS interaction model

In the model of @eq-wcgs-model-1,
write $\odds(p, a) \eqdef \oddst(Y=1|P=p, A=a)$.
Then the personality coefficient $\beta_P$ is the difference in log-odds of CHD
between type A ($P = 1$) and type B ($P = 0$) participants at age $0$:

$$\beta_P = \eta(P = 1, A = 0) - \eta(P=0, A = 0)$$

and $\expf{\beta_P}$ is the corresponding odds ratio:

$$
\expf{\beta_{P}}
= \frac{\odds(P=1, A = 0)}{\odds(P=0, A = 0)}
$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-logistic-coef-interp, worked in @sol-logistic-coef-interp.

:::
